title: Bosch and Siemens Model Dishwashers Recalled by BSH Home Appliances Corporation Due to Fire Hazard
summary: An electrical component in certain model dishwashers can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 476,500.

title: Children's Sunglasses Recalled by Axiom Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the recalled sunglasses can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 5,300.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls Simplicity’s Rainforest™ Portable Play Yards Due to Fall and Entrapment Hazards
summary: One or more rails can collapse unexpectedly, posing a fall or entrapment hazard to young children. Units: About 200,000.

title: Infantino Expands Recall of Infant Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The tail-piece on the rattles can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 131,000 (This recall was first announced in Mar. 2008).

title: Giant Bicycle, Inc. Recalls Bicycles; Fork Can Break Causing Rider To Fall
summary: The density of the steerer tubes can cause the forks to crack and break, posing a fall hazard to the consumer. Units: About 1,000.

title: Toy Xylophones Recalled by The Land of Nod Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The pegs on the xylophone can break, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 500.

title: Cheyenne Industries Recalls Vanity Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The recalled stools can become unstable due to loose screws, which can cause the stool legs to separate or break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 89,000.

title: Risk of Strangulation Prompts Recall of Window Blinds Sold at Cost Plus and World Market Stores
summary: Roman Shades: These shades have a looped pull cord and exposed inner cords on the back of the shade. Looped pull cords and exposed inner cords on roman shades present a strangulation hazard. title: Ryobi Corded Circular Saws Sold Exclusively at Home Depot Recalled By One World Technologies Inc. Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The return spring on the circular saw's lower blade guard can break, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 12,400.

title: Stork Craft Recalls More Than 500,000 Cribs; Mattress Support Bracket Failures Create Risk of Entrapment and Suffocation
summary: The metal support brackets used to support the crib mattress and mattress board can crack and break. When one or more support brackets break, the mattress can collapse and create a dangerous gap between the mattress and crib rails, in which a child can become entrapped and suffocate. Units: About 53

title: TDI International Recalls Toy Cars Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the toy cars contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 150.

title: Top Goods Trading Recalls Flashing Pacifiers Due to Choking and Strangulation Hazard
summary: The flashing pacifiers do not comply with federal safety standards for pacifiers. Although the pacifiers are marketed to older children and adults, they could be given to babies and cause serious injury or death. The pieces of the pacifier can separate, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 38,000.

title: Rashti & Rashti Expands Recall of Infant Garments Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps on these garments can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 16,000 (This recall was first announced in July 2008).

title: Bicycles with RockShox Bicycle Forks Recalled by SRAM LLC Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The steel steerer on the forks can crack, causing the fork to detach from the bicycle frame. This can cause the rider to lose control and crash. Units: About 175.

title: Children's Hooded Jackets with Drawstrings Recalled by Ms. Bubbles Inc. Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 55,000.

title: Jardine Expands Recall of Cribs Sold by Babies"R"Us; Cribs Pose Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The wooden crib slats can break, creating a gap, which can pose an entrapment and strangulation hazard to infants and toddlers. Units: About 56,450 (This recall was first announced in June 2008).

title: Viking Range Corp. Recalls Toasters Due to Shock Hazard
summary: Wiring inside the toaster can become loose and contact the toaster body, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: DDI Inc. Recalls Toy Construction Play Sets Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the play sets can contain lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 3,000.

title: JAKKS Pacific Recalls Spa Factory Aromatherapy Kits Due to Explosion and Projectile Hazards
summary: Pressure from the buildup of carbon dioxide in the jars of Bath Bombs/Balls or Bath Fizzies can cause the caps on the jars to blow off, posing explosion and projectile hazards. The mixtures also can contain citric acid, which can get into the eyes during an explosion, posing a risk of eye irritation

title: L.L. Bean Recalls Ice Cleats Used During Winter Weather Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The elastic harness system attaching the cleats to footwear can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000.

title: Skull-And-Crossbones Necklaces Recalled By Spencer Gifts Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The skull and metal clasp of the necklace contain high levels of lead. Lead can be toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 8,400.

title: Outdoor Research Recalls Warming Gloves Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The glove's electric heating pad can short circuit and overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 900.

title: The Land of Nod Recalls Children's Canopies Due to Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: A child's head could get entrapped in the canopy's window openings, posing entrapment and strangulation hazards. Units: About 2,400.

title: Discount School Supply Recalls Jesus Fish Beads Due to Violation of Lead Paint
summary: Surface paint on the green fish can contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 500.

title: High School Musical Manicure Kits Recalled by Fantas-Eyes Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The lettering "HIGH SCHOOL MUSICAL" with glitter on the pouch used with the manicure kit contains excess levels of lead. Lead can be toxic if ingested by young children and cause adverse health effects. Units: About 15,000.

title: Lane Home Furnishings Recalls Glider Recliners Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The base of the chair, if installed backwards, can allow the chair to tip-over backwards, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 700.

title: Lip Gloss Keychains Recalled By Markwins Beauty Products Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The metal clasp attached to the keychain contains high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 75,000.

title: Milestone AV Technologies Recalls Television Wall Mounts Sold Exclusively At Best Buy; Unit Can Crack, TV Can Fall On Consumers
summary: The wall mount can crack when used with televisions 26 inches and larger or with televisions that include a DVD player. The television can then fall from the wall mount and pose a serious risk of injury to consumers standing nearby. Units: About 140,000.

title: Mad Dog Concepts Recalls Boy's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard
summary: This sleepwear fails to meet the federal children's sleepwear flammability standard, and poses a risk of burn injury to children. Units: About 25,000.

title: Rheem Recalls to Repair Oil-Fired Furnaces Due to Fire Hazard
summary: If the furnace is not properly wired, the oil burner can continue to operate when the blower shuts off, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 14,000.

title: Saris Cycling Group Recalls Stationary Bicycle Trainers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A handle pin on the bicycle trainer can loosen during use, causing the machine to become disengaged, and pose a fall hazard to consumers. Units: 2000.
